title: Flow-polynomial obstructions to the random-cluster bunkbed inequality
description:
Unrefereed candidate: an Eulerian-flow transfer and exact local window U_p intersect [alpha,691/250] = {2}, for every fixed 0<p<1. Full homogeneous finite simple bunkbed counterexamples exist at the other weights in this window. The graph may depend on both parameters. Alpha is not a record lower endpoint. Global classification and integer q>=3 remain unresolved.

Producer-side exact reconstruction and negative controls; no formal verification or external human peer review established. Original prose/data CC0-1.0, original code MIT; third-party material retains its terms.
